tei:div.tei:p: "$ (297)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bsnyen bsgrub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun

bzhugs so// (298)༄༅// na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa mchog gi gtso// spyan ras gzigs dbang de la 'tshal te// de nyid bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa dang*// dus bzang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bri bar bya/ de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la bdun te/ dus dang*/ gnas dang*/ dgod pa bshams pa/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshogs zhing ngo*// dang po dus ni/ bsnyen sgrub kyi dus sam/ dbang bskur rab gnas kyi dus sam/ las tshogs phrin las kyi dus sam/ nya stong brgyad gsum dus bzang du'o// gnyis pa gnas ni khrid gzhung du gsal lo// gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal dbang bskur ltar bsham/ ma 'dzoms na phying pa dri ma med pa'i steng du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/ bla ma dang thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi rten bkram/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ lnga'am/ gsum las mi nyung bar bsham/ tshogs kyi yo byad (299) bzang shing rgya che ba rnams dang*/ ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba mdun tu bzhag /rdo rje dril bu cang te'u la sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad kun tshang bar byas la gdan bde bar 'khod do// bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog he ru ka sku mchog dmar po zhal gcig /phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra sma ra me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang khur rta skad 'tsher ba/ g.yas dbyug to nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum sgrub dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na ye shes pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa/ thugs kar hrīḥyig la sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la gtor ma rta mgrin las sngags kyis bsang*/

oṃ swa bhā wa (300)shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswabhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ zhu ba las byung pa'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ ā hūm̐ zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur bar bsam la/ ham̐'u mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi mthu la brten nas/ gang dag bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dang gnas 'dir gnas pa thams cad gtor ma 'bul ba'i slad du 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭāk+ki rā tsa hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bkug la rdo rje bsdam pa gyen du phyes la/ namaḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bo shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā kha ut+ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛh+ṇi daṃ ba ling+ta ye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ gang dag dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i las la dgyes pa'i 'byung po rnams/ gtor ma 'di mnyes shing tshims nas chos dang mthun pa'i phrin las sgrubs shig /cho ga nyan cing blta bar mi rung ba'i bgegs kyi rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs shig / ces gtor ma phyir bskyal/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+rī wa hu lu hu lu ham̐'u phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bhā ni sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyis bdug /rol mo drag tu bya'o/ rdo rje gsor ro// srung 'khor bsgom mo// ham̐'u/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun// mkha' 'gro'i ra ba rdo rje'i gur// bskal pa'i me dpung 'tshubs shing 'khyil// rnam rtog las gyur bgegs rnams kun// mtshams bcad nang 'di tshun chad du// nam yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ham̐'u/ lnga pa mchod pa byin brlabs ni/

oṃ hrīḥpad+mata kṛta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu ham̐'u phaṭa/ sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swabhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ gis sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las (301)a las thod pa'i snod yang shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥham̐'u zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /gdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ thogs pa med pa dngos bshams yid kyis sprul zhing 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥham̐'u zhes pa nas/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ oṃ badz+ra shap+da āḥham̐'u/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab bo/ /drug pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni/ bdag dang ma rgan sems can thams cad bla ma dang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum sogs bya/ sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gsum brjod do// skabs 'dir rdor sems bsgom lugs kyang yod/ bdun pa tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs su gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ po ta la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba bdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas/

ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ swā hā/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bgyi// (302)sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge las byang chub myur thob shog / sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can ma lus bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gsum brjod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la bgod// ces pa'i bar gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs// sprul sku mi tra dzo ki la gsol ba 'debs// paṇa chen shrī pu tra la gsol ba 'debs// rtogs ldan girti rat+na la gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun bud+dha shrī la gsol ba 'debs// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs// dbang bzhi bskur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi sna tshogs rnams rang la thim pa gyur// oṃ āḥham̐'u gis bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi bdag bskyed dang bdun bskyed sgrub cing*/

de nyid mchod cing bstod pa dang gsum las/ dang po mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas bskyed rim sgom pa'i thogs pa tshad med bzhi sgom pa na/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang (303)sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /chags sdang nye ring gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces lan gsum bsgom mo// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥsarba dhārmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong zhing bdag med par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs lnga'i steng du ri bo mchog rab/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar ham̐'u las rdo rje ham̐'u gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ srung pa'i 'khor lo yangs par gyur pa'i dbus su/ bh+rūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan 'od du zhu ba las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas kyi khang par gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga pa/ rta babs bzhi tog dang bcas pa/ phyi rdo ra me ris bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po tshegs drag dang bcas pa dang*/ baṃ yig dmar po las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ thams cad jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi sar bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i sdong po lte bar hrīḥdang baṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ pad+ma hrīḥdang baṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ nor bus ska rags thabs su 'ching ba/ phyag dang po (304)gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas nor bu rin po che dkar po'i phreng ba brgya rtsa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin cing*/ rab rgyas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ spyan dkyus dang smin dkyus ring zhing mdzod spu dkar po brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan nag po gyen la bcings shing*/ ral pa'i zar bu rked par sleb pa/ me tog gi phreng bas skra chings can ut+pal sngon po gnyis kyis snyan gong brgyan pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa rin po che sna lngas rtse phran lnga dang*/ snyan cha dang mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/ 'og pag dang*/ mu tig sna lnga'i chun po dang*/ dar gyi cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i pang na yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked pa la 'khril pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi ḍā ma ru nam mkhar 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun gyis bkang ba yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ zhal khro 'dzum cung zad bzhad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog dang zar bus rked par g.yogs pa/ thod skam rin po ches rtse bran gyis mtshan pa lngas dbur brgyan cing dkar 'dzin dang chu 'dzin rgyas pa/ zhi ba 'dzum pa/ gzhon cing sgeg pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing*/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba'o// yab kyi gnas lngar pad zla'i gdan re rer gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ las rnam snang spyan ras gzigs yab yum dkar po// mgrin par hrīḥlas (305)'od dpag med spyan ras gzigs yab yum dmar po/

snying gar ham̐'u las mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs yab yum sngon po/ lte bar traṃ' las rin 'byung spyan ras gzigs yab yum ser po// gsang gnas su āḥlas don grub spyan ras gzigs yab yum ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang gtso bo yab yum gyi cha lugs su bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo// nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo// byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi cung zad gtsigs shing g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /gru mo na kha twaṃ' ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi gar gyis/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de ltar lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ham̐'u sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥham̐'u bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i ham̐'u las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yab yum rnams kyis bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang gang*/ chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes (306)sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥganas pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad spyan ras gzigs rigs lnga zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pas gang*/

'od zer 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog pas thams cad spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi skur gyur pa'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra sgrogs par gyur/ par bsam la sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me ham̐'u/ ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ zhes ma yengs pa'i sems kyis bsnyen pa ci 'grub 'dren no// 'phro 'jog pa ni/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bden pas bdag dang sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ 'og gi lag mchod 'dir byed na legs/ 'di'i bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ dus zla ba gsum/ grangs bsnyen bye ba gsum/ mtshan ma'i rtags rab mngon sum du yab yum gyi zhal mthong ba dang lung ston pa rnams 'byung*/ 'bring nyams snang*/ tha ma rmi lam du mi dkar po dang bud med dmar mos dngos grub ster ba dang khrom 'du ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor las sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swabhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs pa'i steng du/

zhes pa nas/ dpag tu med pa'i 'os zer 'phros/ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar ro// 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhes pa nas/ snying gar ham̐'u sngon po/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin no// mdun bskyed kyi dus su gong gi mgrin pa snying gar lte ba gsang gnas kyi spyan ras gzigs yab yum rnams mdun nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor du gdan la 'khod pa'i lugs kyang yod do// mkha' 'gro bzhi (307) mtshams bzhir bkod pa'o// bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i ham̐'u las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas bka' brgyud bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spos dang rol mo 'dzin pas/ hrīḥ sku gsum dbyer med gzhal yas nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// sems can smin mdzad thugs rje can// bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol// rang bzhin gnas mchog gzhal yas nas// sku gsum lha tshogs 'khor gyis bskor// stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// snyan brgyud lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// mkha' spyod u rgyan gzhal yas nas// byin rlabs dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// las dang ye shes las la sogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// rang bzhin dur khrod gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad cing*// phyi nang bar chad sel mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrīḥ rin chen sna tshogs pho brang 'dir// sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan steng du// yid 'ong mdzes pa'i zhal yas su// snyan brgyud lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur// ces pas nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur// ces pa'i bar gong ltar ro// skabs 'dir bzlas pa byed par spro na'ang gong ltar bya'o// de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'dza' tshon lta bur sprul// thugs rjes 'gro ba ma lus (308)'dren mdzad pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang lha tshogs phyag 'tshal lo// de nas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ yon tan me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo sil snyan mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// zhim pa'i dri dang mngar ba'i ro// reg bya 'dod yon mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// nang mchod bdud rtsis kyang mchod do/ /gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga// phung po khams dang skyed mched lnga/ dbang po yul lnga 'byung ba lnga// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// dga' ba bzhi dang bde ba brgyad// skad cig bzhi dang ye shes lnga// zung 'jug dga' bde'i mchod pa 'di// dkyil 'khor lha yi bzhes su gsol// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod mkhan mchod pa mchod pa'i yul// sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes pa// spros bral don dam mchod pa 'di// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// de nas bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces tshig bzhi dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// ces tshig bzhi dang*/ hrīḥ rnam par snang mdzad gti mug rnam dag pas// gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes bdag /rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi bdag nyid can// rnam snang spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje sems dpa' zhe sdang rnam dag pas// rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes bdag

/rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi bdag nyid can// mi bskyod spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen 'byung ldan nga rgyal rnam dag pas// tshor phung gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi bdag nyid can// rin 'byung spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// snang ba mtha' (309)yas 'dod chags rnam dag pas// 'du shes gnas gyur sor rtogs ye shes bdag /rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi bdag nyid can// snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod grub pa phrag dog rnam dag pas// 'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes bdag /rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dag nyid can// don grub spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde stong gnyis su med pa yi// gsang ba ye shes phyag 'tshal bstod// nam mkha' rnam par dag pa yi// chos dbyings lha rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi// dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// chu khams rnam par dag pa yi// rdo rje'i lha rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi// ma mā ki la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa khams rnam par dag pa yi// rin chen lha rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi// sangs rgyas spyan mar phyag 'tshal bstod// me khams rnam par dag pa yi// pad+ma'i lha rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi// gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal bstod// rlung khams rnam par dag pa yi// las kyi lha rnams 'byung ba'i gzhi// dam tshig sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i*// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang gi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// mngon spyod phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// las kyi mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod pa yis// mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub stsol// don gnyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes bstod cing gsol ba btab bo// lag mchod bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab ni// las sngags kyis bsang*/

swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ (310)las me/ kaṃ gsum las thod pa'i sgyed po gsum gyi steng du a las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du// go ku da ha na las sha lnga de nyid kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga la de nyid kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ham̐'u bh+rūm̐ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥham̐'u gis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i ham̐'u las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa dros rdzas rnams khol/ rlangs pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ la phog /de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ oṃ āḥham̐'u dang bcas pa thod par lhung zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u ha ho hrīḥ ces lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis rim pa bzhin du bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ ngag tu/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor mi tra dzo ki'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen shrī pu tra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtogs ldan girti rat+na'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med 'od dpag rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang rgyud man ngag ston pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// brag mgon la sogs dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ tshangs pa phyogs skyong bcu po sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/

bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ (311)skye ba gnas bzhir bsdus pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad bdud rtsis tshims nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig / gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ tshogs mchod dang gtong rag gi mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ tshogs kyi byin rlabs nang mchod ltar byas la/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di dag /byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥham̐'u/ pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ zhes pa ni bsdus pa'o// rgyas par byed na/ hrīḥ bla ma brgyud par bcas pa dang*// yi dam lha tshogs ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas rnams// zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// ces spyan drangs la/ tshogs bstab pa ni/ spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du// chos longs sprul sku'i lha tshogs dang*// bka' rgyud bla ma 'khor dang bcas// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo ni// rnam par snang mdzad yab yum dang*// sangs rgyas rigs kyi lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na// tshe dpag med pa yab yum dang*// pad+ma rigs kyi lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig

/a la la ste dgyes par rol// snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo na// (312)mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum dang*// rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na// rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum dang*// yon tan rigs kyi lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo na// don yod grub pa yab yum dang*// las kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// mig sogs skye mched dag pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' sems ma la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// mgo sogs lhu tshigs dag pa yi// khro bo khro mo bcu po la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// rtsa khams rnam par dag pa yi// dpa' bo'i lha tshogs ma lus la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// rlung khams rnam par dag pa yi// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lus la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// thig le rnam par dag pa yi// gsang sngags lha tshogs thams cad la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// lus kyi zhing rdul rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' (313)la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// rang lus rnam par dag pa yi// sku yi rdo rje'i lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig

/a la la ste dgyes par rol// rang ngag rnam par dag pa yi// gsung gi rdo rje'i lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// rang sems rnam par dag pa yi// thugs kyi rdo rje'i lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /a la la ste dgyes par rol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub tu gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod 'tshal// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi// ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ tshogs chang lag mchod ltar 'bul zhing nam mkha' gtor/ tshogs phud bcad la dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma 'bul lo// gtor ma ni/ gong gi las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ gong gi lag mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ gtor mgron spyan drangs shing 'bul ba ni/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ pheṃ leṃ/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu gtor ma la zug te gsol bar gyur/ na mo gu ru rat+na i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis bla ma dang*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u hrīḥ o ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis 'bul/ gzhan yang yi dam gang byed 'di'i gsham du (314) bzud do// ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bla ma dang 'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mnyes nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab bo// chos skyong ba'i gtor ma ni// bsang sbyang gong ltar dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu byin gyis brlabs la/

bskyed chog bsdus pa ni/ /oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar mdung dang ral gri gshibs pa'i gur khang*/ ma mo dang rlung nag 'tshub pa'i dbus/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i steng*/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan la ham̐'u dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dpal ye shes kyi brag mgon sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ 'jigs pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar du 'khyug pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas kyi phyag na beng dbyug zur bzhi rtse mor nor bus mtshan pa me stag 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas par bu'i nang du dgra snying dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ thod rlon lnga bcus do shal/ sbrul nag gdug pa can gyi se ra kha dang yan lag thams cad brgyan pa/ sku smad la stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ dar nag po'i 'jog ber gsol ba/ sku la me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ gdug pa can thams cad bsreg pa'o// de'i mdun du las mkhan mon pa nag po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas kyis gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa dgra snying gis (315)bkang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stobs pa/ gzhan yang ye shes kyi mgon po sprin ltar du gtibs pa/ las kyi mgon po dang*/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ gzhan yang ma mo dang gshin rje'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar ham̐'u/ de las 'od 'phros bsil ba'i tshal nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/

rgyas par spro na/ ham̐'u dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /zhes sogs spyan 'dren no// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu gtor ma la zug par gyur/ oṃ ma hā kā la dhu ru swa ham̐'u ham̐'u phaṭa phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum dang*/ shā sa na 'i sngags kyis mgon po spyi la 'bul/ dpal ldan lha mo gang byed bskyed la/ rang sngags sam/ yang na/ trag rag mo ba li ti khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa ma hā rak+ṣi ṇa nag mo dun ting bh+yo/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ 'gal rkyen zlog /dgra bgegs tshar bcad du gsol/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ spyan drangs la rang sngags kyis 'bul ba'am/ yang na/ mkha' 'gro lnga'i 'khor na gnas pa/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ sku gsung thugs mnyes nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol cig / gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/ dkar gtor du byin gyis brlabs la/ gzhan yang bod khams (316)skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis yul so so'i gzhi bdag /gnas ri khrod kyi srung ma dam tshig can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// mnyes shing tshims nas chos dang mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig /gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye ba gnas bzhir bsdus pa'i sems can rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /ar+ghaṃ la sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod kyis kyang mchod la/

bstod pa ni/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// hrīḥ rnam par snang mdzad gti mug rnam dag pas/ /ces pa nas/ don gnyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol// ces pa'i bar gyis bstod/ ham̐'u las byung ba'i nag po mthu bo che// spyan ras gzigs mgon bka' srung dam tshig can// brag lha mgon po mgon po 'bum gyi rje// sangs rgyas bstan srung nag po khyod la bstod// bh+yo/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyis mthus// 'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas// 'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud// lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus par ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs (317)su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel shing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog

/ de nas tshogs la rol ba ni// las kyi slob dpon gyis thabs shes kyi rdzas steng 'og tu bzung la bsnol nas/ kyai rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol ba gsum/ rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes slob dpon la drang ngo*// slob dpon gyis pad kor dang ldan pas/ ham̐'u/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i// de kho na nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// a la la ho/ tshul des mched lcam rnams la yang drang ngo*// thams cad kyi lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems chos nyid kyi ngang nas tshogs la rol lo// de nas lhag ma rnams snod gcig tu bsdus la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas kha chus bran la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li ho pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas g.yon nas g.yas su smin mtshams su skor/ yaṃ raṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phud dang lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing chu che ba/ zad mi shes pa 'dod pa'i yon tan (318)lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa yi swā hā/ lhag ma dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad tshims par gyur cig lhag ma bskyang ba ni/ ham̐'u gzhan yang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma// myur mgyogs rtsal ldan thams cad dang*// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// khro gtum 'jigs par ston rnams dang*// sha za mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// stong gsum dbang du sdud rnams dang*// las la myur ba'i pho nya rnams// dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs la// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs// log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs thul// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces nam mkha' mthong sar gtor la/ bshal chu bskyangs la/ phyogs bcu 'jig rten skyong ba yi// bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma rnams// 'dir gshegs bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod//

ces nam mkha' gtor ro/ /de nas gtor snod kha sbub la gtor bro ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du// snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i lha// mkha' 'gro kun la dbang sgyur ma// 'jig pa'i gad mo ham̐'u sgra can// ḍā ki rgya mtsho spungs se spung*// mdzes pa'i gar thabs sha ra ra// 'dir gshegs bstan la sdang ba rnams// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me ham̐'u/ ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gnod byed thams cad sta bha ya nan nan/ zhes dgra bgegs thams cad ri rab kyi 'og tu mnan par bsam/ gnyis pa rjes chog ni/ rgyas par spro na mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ gtsang sbyar ma sogs mchod pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ nang mchod bdud rtsis kyang mchod la bstod pa ni/ (319)sangs rgyas mang pos rab tu bsngags// yon tan mchog gi gter gyur pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'khor dang bcas// rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas bzod par gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing*/ bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// cho ga lhag chad ci mchis pa// dkyil 'khor lha yi bzod par mdzod// de nas bsngo ba ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /bla ma yi dam grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces brjod/ bkra shis ni/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che// yon tan phun tshogs chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam// bdag cag skye gu'i 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang la sogs pa'i// bdag gis me tog phog pa'i lha// las dang skal ba ldan pa yi// yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med pa// 'dod dgur sgyur pa'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che// ma sring byams pa'i tshul kyis grogs mdzad ma// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog// bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ham̐'u las byung ba'i nag po mthu po che// spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' srung dam tshig can// brag lha mgon po mgon po 'bum gyi rje// sangs rgyas bstan srung chen po'i bkra shis shog/ /ces bkra shis brjod/ brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ /mgon po thugs rje chen po dang (320)ldan pa rnams kyis rten 'di la 'byung ba sa chu me rlung gis ma gnod kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dam pa mdzad du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ rten mi bzhugs na gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams bdag nyid la thim par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis bsdu'o/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ /zhes se gol brdeb cing*/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs su gsol// de nas snod bcud rten gzhal yas khang nas// sa bon nā da'i bar dang de las 'das te// don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi rang la yun ring du mnyam par gzhag /slar zung 'jug gi skur ldangs te gong bzhin bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang ngo*// spyod lam rnal 'byor dang rdzogs rim zhib par sgrub thabs chen mor ltos shig /spyan ras gzigs dbang sgrub/ mi tra'i lugs/ pa'i thabs// bde gsal don blo dman kyi/

du 'thad ldan pa'i// lung dang bla ma'i man ngag bzhin// gzhan gyis bya btang chos rje bskul phyir kho bos 'od dpag rdo rje// bsdebs/ nongs par mkha' 'gros bzod par bzhes// dge ba sems can don phyir bsngo// 'dis rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin par gyur cig// dge legs 1$1000300 'phel/
